title: One header style and a shorter scene banner
summary: Main screens share one header, and the scene above each screen shrinks to a short band after your first visit.
items: Party, Market, Encounters and the feature screens (Downtime, Bank, Trade Exchanges and the rest) show a small section label, the title and the main action in the same place.
Market's ⋯ menu leads DMs to Trade Exchanges and Shop schedules.

With Show fantasy backgrounds on, the full scene greets your first visit to a screen on this device; later visits, split view and a phone turned sideways use a short band, so the main action stays in the first screen.
